jurisdiction: General assessment; used in county CAMA systems
summary: CAMA data elements describing construction quality, condition, effective age, and physical/functional state of improvements.
plain_language: Quality and condition codes are how the assessor's database describes how well-built and how worn a structure is.

relationships.note: Quality and condition affect depreciation estimates.
Property record should preserve characteristic data.

source_refs.citation: IAAO, Standard on Mass Appraisal of Real Property.
